text.p: -- NatWest Securities said on Tuesday it had upgraded its rating for Spanish oil company Repsol to accumulate from hold.

-- "Repsol's results so far in 1996 have been held back by declines in chemical earnings, but the company has a relatively low overall sensitivity to the current cyclical decline in chemical margins," analysts Adam Sieminski, Holly Gustafson and Jennifer Weinstein wrote in a report.
-- "Repsol's growth in earnings over the 1996-2000 period of about 11 percent per year is second only to Total SA in the major oils group."
-- They added, "Repsol has three substantial sources of earnings growth (in addition to cost control) -- exploration and production, refining and marketing, and natural gas."
-- Repsol's American Depositary Receipt was up 1/4 to 35-1/2 on Tuesday afternoon.
